pages.text:
Experience as a glowing pale-green liquid: 20 mB per experience point. It's in the c:experience tag, so other mods' liquid experience works with it, and it fills any tank and bucket.
# XP Drain
A thin grate placed on top of a fluid container (a Reservoir, a Fluid Tank, another mod's tank).
- Experience orbs that land on it run into the container below.
- Sneak on it to pour your own experience in, a level at a time.

# XP Shower
A fixture hung under a block. Feed it Liquid Experience through its top: a conduit, or a tank right above it, which it draws from.
- Sneak under it (up to 3 blocks down) to take experience, a level at a time.
- A redstone signal turns it off.
# Vacuum Collector
It also gathers experience orbs in its range into a 16,000 mB Liquid Experience tank, which fluid conduits drain from its output faces.
Rates are in the experience config.
